author: Mike Kasberg
units: mm assumed; corroborated by source sheet dimensions, STL contains no units
sourceDefects: 27 edge-adjacent components, nonwatertight. Used as design reference only; original CSG reconstruction, no automatic repair.

mapping.socket: Measured 4.50 mm length retained at all three joints; width sheet + proposed .10–.30 total allowance
mapping.tongue: 4.50 minus total allowance; two base tongues and one top tongue, shoulders stop insertion flush
mapping.runners: Original 12 accessible .4–.6 mm bed-level tabs; unlike source low .21/.22 mm runner planes
mapping.newGeometry: Original tapered vertical pedestal with central horizontal vibration plate on a broad fixed base. No source triangles copied.

differences: Not a stencil/loom reskin: central support, rim reach, plate silhouettes and pedestal form determine a physical tapping/vibration experiment. No mode-shape simulation, resonant frequency prediction or acoustic performance claimed.
